name: After § 2
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 2 a. Notes that the current system of budgetary conditionality linked to the rule of law is not used to protect the financial interests of the Union, but systematically used to harass certain Member States and interfere in the decisions of their democratically elected governments on the basis of an election and a programme; Considers that this climate of tension and bureaucratic interference in democratic life jeopardises cooperation between Member States and jeopardises the reputation of the Commission among the peoples of Europe;
